ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant low-intensity (black) pigment and sparse high-intensity (white) scarring, approximately 9:1 ratio of dark to light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous pixel mass across both lobes; high-intensity pixel clusters appearing as localized linear streaks (left lobe) and localized circular blobs (lower-right lobe).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with approximately 55-degree internal angle, showing high pixel depth relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with irregular peak-to-valley spacing across the entire trailing edge boundary, creating a jagged edge-profile against the high-intensity background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch extending to the distal tips, characterized by significant irregular interruptions along the boundary curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters on the right lobe, primarily concentrated on the distal and lower-medial areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear pixel disruptions visible; two prominent diagonal marks on the left lobe and vertical scratches on the central-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake-mark scarring across the ventral surface and rosette-pattern scarring; significant irregular erosion of the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Embedded metadata text block in the lower third of the image field (JAC01-48/28 ID 13632).
